_doc: The Cage (act3/the_cage.md, seats per act3/the_cage_seats.md; M5-A3P-1851): frame (brass gone to patina, lacquer-black joints, the seats, the shackle rings, the gimbals and the gold-leaf rims), lampbar (the salt-glass chimney tubes: glimmer_bound, steady; dark on the broken quarters by vertex emission), crown (the crown lamps' globes, likewise), chain (wet black iron with a patina bloom), clasp (the keystone clasps; the weak point's hairline seam in spawn_wound, one per quarter, ADR 0151). No glimmer_lift on the frame, ever. write_materials.py on game/shaders/creature/creature.gdshader.
